retrievalProfile.description: A retro-futuristic 80s style featuring heavy chrome-textured custom lettering with a liquid reflection and integrated tropical motifs.
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif corporate branding is requested
naturalistic photography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A central stack of two-tier chrome lettering with a high-gloss metallic finish, featuring a palm tree integrated into the final character, all resting on a reflective liquid pool against a grainy purple-to-black gradient background.
coreVisualRelationships: Chrome text reflecting a sunset horizon line
Vertical stack of two words with tight interlocking
Liquid puddle mirroring the text vertically
Palm tree silhouette integrated into the rightmost letter
coreInvariants: Metallic chrome texture with a horizontal 'horizon' reflection line across all glyphs.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered typographic block occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright chrome lettering and its corresponding blue liquid reflection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left secondary text, down to the main chrome logo, following the palm tree curve, and ending at the liquid reflection.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep purple grainy texture surrounding the central metallic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and indigo background with a grainy texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright silver and cyan chrome highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold and peach sunset tones within the chrome reflections and palm tree.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, saturated background and the bright, reflective metallic foreground.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric lowercase with circular counters and elongated ascenders.
letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky strokes with rounded outer corners
Deep 3D extrusion with a metallic bevel
Interlocking characters where ascenders and descenders overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: The final letter on the right merges into a stylized palm tree trunk and fronds.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between heavy, illustrative chrome lettering and a clean, wide-tracked minimalist sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the circular counters and geometric structure of the main logo.
Matches the clean, wide-tracked metadata text at the top.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy purple-to-black gradient background with a blue liquid puddle at the bottom center. Include a stylized palm tree silhouette on the right side of the puddle area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom 3D chrome lettering with a horizontal sunset reflection. The text should sit directly above the liquid puddle, with a distorted vertical reflection appearing inside the puddle.

verificationChecks: Is the chrome texture reflecting a horizon line?
Is the palm tree integrated into the lettering?
Is there a liquid reflection below the main text?
Is the background a grainy purple gradient?

adjustableVariables: Chrome reflection colors (sunset vs. cool tones)
mustRedesign: Exact character shapes that mimic trademarked identities
postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen consistency across all letters.
Ensure the reflection in the puddle matches the text above.
Verify the palm tree is seamlessly joined to the typography.
Confirm the grain texture is subtle and uniform in the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Chrome + Liquid Reflection + Tropical Iconography + Grainy Gradient
